parsed.scan_reading: CABIRIA, festivals in honour of the cabiri, celebrated in Thebes and Lemnos, but especially in Samothracia, an island consecrated to the cabiri. All who were initiated into the mysteries of these gods, were thought to be secured thereby from storms at sea, and all other dangers.
parsed.explanation: The scan prints CABIRIA, not fests, gods, and the OCR misread long-s and other letters, corrupting the passage about the Cabeiri.
